method: Python 3 scanned every instruction record in all 5,253 full-pass5 exported .asm files. For each exact 32-bit global-address literal, it classified the operand text as [absolute-address] or a non-memory literal. Python also verified selected writer encodings against original bytes.

bounded_findings: Within the 5,253 exported assembly records, no exact target address literal appears as a non-memory operand. Thus this export corpus has no direct MOV-reg-immediate (or comparable immediate-literal) producer for these exact addresses.
This result complements, but does not replace, report 126's absolute-writer inventory.
It does not exclude a computed address formed from another value, data-held pointer aliases, non-exported code, or runtime writes.
